content: this is a summary of a civil case that took place in the vilnius regional district court the case involves two parties one of which is anonymized the applicant had to pay professional fees and stamp duty while the defendant 2 had to pay stamp duty the court resolved the case by distributing several vehicles and bank accounts the peugeot 207 vehicle was awarded to the applicant while the remaining vehicles went to the defendant the funds in separate bank accounts will be divided accordingly the court also addressed issues related to the dissolution of the marriage maintenance for children and division of property the court partially upheld the applicants claims and ordered the defendant to pay maintenance and nonpecuniary damages the court determined the costs of the proceedings and ordered the parties to pay accordingly the court postponed the payment of stamp duty and clarified issues related to the residence of the children and the division of property the court made its decisions based on the relevant articles of the civil procedure code of lithuania the text concludes by dismissing the remaining parts of the application and counterclaim

metadata.cost: - € 71.00 (professional fees) + € 240,00 (stamp duty )to be borne by the applicant; € 61,00 (stamp duty) to be borne by the defendant
